summary: Phase 1 testing complete for GROUPE YAMA+ e-commerce platform. Tested PayDunya payment integration (Wave, Orange Money, Card), manager notifications, order creation with correct payment statuses, and admin dashboard statistics. All 11 backend tests pass, all 8 frontend tests pass.

paydunya_payment_methods.details: GET /api/payments/paydunya/methods returns Wave, Orange Money, Card, Free Money, Expresso, Djamo

paydunya_payment_initiation.details: POST /api/payments/paydunya/initiate creates payment invoice with PayDunya API

order_creation_cash.details: Cash orders get payment_status='cod_pending' and order_status='confirmed'

order_creation_online.details: Online payment orders get payment_status='pending' and order_status='awaiting_payment'

manager_notifications.details: Manager email notifications sent via Resend on order creation

admin_dashboard_stats.details: Only confirmed orders (paid, cod_pending) counted in stats, pending orders tracked separately

product_page.details: Product page displays correctly with add to cart, wishlist, price alert buttons

checkout_page.details: Checkout page shows payment methods (Mobile Money, Cash, Card)

admin_login.details: Admin can login with admin@yamaplus.com / Admin123!

seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix for payment status verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayDunya payment integration is fully tested. Key endpoints: /api/payments/paydunya/initiate, /api/payments/paydunya/callback, /api/payments/paydunya/verify/{order_id}, /api/payments/paydunya/methods. Order creation correctly sets payment_status based on payment method (cod_pending for cash, pending for online). Admin stats only count confirmed orders. Product variants feature not tested as no products with variants exist in database.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. All features working as expected.
